subject: Good modern evaluations of distance sampling

messages.author: 9cfb65a737424404
messages.subject: Good modern evaluations of distance sampling
parts:
Hello,

I'm looking for modern evaluations of distance sampling with birds
where the absolute densities of the species were accurately known and
distance sampling methods were applied properly, e.g. Nelson and Fancy
(1999). Other suggestions welcome.

Stephen.

messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: Good modern evaluations of distance sampling
parts:
Stephen:

Have a look at the searchable distance sampling bibliography put
together by Tiago Marques

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distancesamplingreferences/

If you search for 'point transect' or 'bird' or 'avian' and sort them in
reverse chronological order, you will generate a number of hits
beginning with the most recent. Many of them will have links to PDFs.
One of those hits will be

@article{Buckland2006,
author = {Buckland, S. T.},
title = {Point transect surveys for songbirds: robust methodologies},
journal = {The Auk},
year = {2006},
volume = {123},
number = {2},
pages = {345--345}
}

among others.
